codeBindings.commitMessage:
[intent:I2.1] fix: skip sanitization for OpenAI-native call_ IDs to prevent tool-result mismatch

OpenAI generates call IDs with the "call_" prefix that may contain base64
characters (+, /) in __thought__ suffixes. Sanitizing these IDs replaces
those characters with underscores, but OpenAI internally tracks the original
ID — causing "tool_result does not match any tool_use" errors.

Fix: return call_ prefixed IDs unchanged in sanitizeToolUseId(). The
sanitization logic is still needed for Gemini/OpenRouter IDs (e.g.
functions.read_file:0) which contain dots and colons that violate the
^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ pattern required by the OpenAI API.

cbf801cc-94cd-4bc7-9416-209664ee665e.assumption: 修复点在 sanitizeToolUseId：对 call_ 前缀的 ID 跳过清洗。这是唯一需要改动的地方。
